  function scalar(value, fallback = "") {
    if (value === undefined || value === null) return fallback;
    if (Array.isArray(value)) return scalar(value[0], fallback);
    if (typeof value === "object" && "@value" in value) return value["@value"];
    return value;
  }

  function refs(value) {
    if (!value) return [];
    return (Array.isArray(value) ? value : [value]).map((item) => item?.["@id"]).filter(Boolean);
  }

  function shortName(iri) {
    return iri.includes(":") ? iri.split(":").pop() : iri;
  }

  function ticketIdFromResource(iri) {
    return iri.split("/").pop();
  }

  function parseJsonLd(document) {
    const graph = document["@graph"] || [];
    state.classCount = graph.filter((item) => item["@type"] === "owl:Class").length;
    state.propertyCount = graph.filter((item) => ["owl:ObjectProperty", "owl:DatatypeProperty"].includes(item["@type"])).length;

    state.nodes = graph.filter((item) => item["bank:visualType"] && item["bank:visualType"] !== "SemanticAssertion").map((item) => ({
      id: item["@id"],
      type: scalar(item["bank:visualType"]),
      name: scalar(item["rdfs:label"], scalar(item["bank:name"], item["@id"])),
      description: scalar(item["bank:description"]),
      layer: scalar(item["bank:layer"], "business"),
      support_count: scalar(item["bank:supportCount"], 0),
      confidence: scalar(item["bank:confidence"]),
      source_type: scalar(item["bank:sourceType"]),
      data_type: scalar(item["bank:dataType"]),
      domain: scalar(item["bank:domainCode"]),
      process: scalar(item["bank:processCode"]),
      asset_id: scalar(item["bank:assetId"]),
      physical_name: scalar(item["bank:physicalName"]),
      legacy_id: scalar(item["bank:legacyIdentifier"]),
      evidence_ticket_ids: refs(item["bank:evidenceTicket"]).map(ticketIdFromResource),
      raw: item,
    }));
    state.nodes.forEach((node) => state.nodeById.set(node.id, node));

    const statements = graph.filter((item) => item["@type"] === "rdf:Statement");
    state.edges = statements.map((statement, index) => {
      const predicate = shortName(statement["rdf:predicate"]?.["@id"] || "relatedTo");
      return {
        _id: `statement-${index}`,
        statement_id: statement["@id"],
        source: statement["rdf:subject"]?.["@id"],
        target: statement["rdf:object"]?.["@id"],
        type: predicate,
        layer: scalar(statement["bank:layer"], mappingPredicates.has(predicate) ? "mapping" : "business"),
        support_count: scalar(statement["bank:supportCount"], 0),
        confidence: scalar(statement["bank:confidence"]),
        evidence_ticket_ids: refs(statement["bank:evidenceTicket"]).map(ticketIdFromResource),
      };
    }).filter((edge) => state.nodeById.has(edge.source) && state.nodeById.has(edge.target));

    graph.filter((item) => item["@type"] === "bank:SupportTicket").forEach((ticketResource) => {
      Object.entries(ticketPredicates).forEach(([property, predicate]) => {
        refs(ticketResource[property]).forEach((target, index) => {
          if (!state.nodeById.has(target)) return;
          state.edges.push({
            _id: `ticket-${ticketResource["@id"]}-${predicate}-${index}`,
            source: ticketResource["@id"], target, type: predicate,
            layer: predicate === "resolvedBy" ? "mapping" : "evidence",
            support_count: 1, evidence_ticket_ids: [scalar(ticketResource["rdfs:label"])],
          });
        });
      });
      state.ticketResourceById.set(scalar(ticketResource["rdfs:label"]), ticketResource["@id"]);
    });
  }

  function buildIndexes() {
    state.edges.forEach((edge) => {
      state.edgeById.set(edge._id, edge);
      [edge.source, edge.target].forEach((id) => {
        if (!state.adjacency.has(id)) state.adjacency.set(id, []);
        state.adjacency.get(id).push(edge);
      });
    });
    state.tickets.forEach((ticket) => state.ticketById.set(ticket.ticket_id, ticket));
    state.assets.forEach((asset) => state.assetById.set(asset.asset_id, asset));
  }

  function toCyNode(node) {
    return { group: "nodes", data: { id: node.id, label: node.name || node.id, type: node.type, layer: node.layer, discoveredAt: state.sessionNodeStep.get(node.id) || 0 } };
  }

  function toCyEdge(edge, showLabels) {
    return { group: "edges", data: {
      id: edge._id, source: edge.source, target: edge.target, type: edge.type, layer: edge.layer,
      displayLabel: predicateLabels[edge.type] || edge.type, labelOpacity: showLabels ? 0.92 : 0,
      supportCount: edge.support_count || 0,
    }};
  }

  function graphLane(type) {
    if (type === "BusinessDomain") return 0;
    if (type === "BusinessProcess") return 1;
    if (["BusinessEntity", "BusinessConcept"].includes(type)) return 2;
    if (["BusinessAttribute", "BusinessEvent", "BusinessMetric", "BusinessAction", "BusinessRole", "QuestionIntent"].includes(type)) return 3;
    if (type === "Table") return 4;
    if (["Column", "Schema", "Database"].includes(type)) return 5;
    if (type === "SupportTicket") return 6;
    return 3;
  }

  function applySessionPositions() {
    const laneCounts = new Map();
    state.sessionPositions.forEach((position, id) => {
      const lane = graphLane(state.nodeById.get(id)?.type);
      const nextRow = Math.floor((position.y - 80) / 76) + 1;
      laneCounts.set(lane, Math.max(laneCounts.get(lane) || 0, nextRow));
    });
    state.cy.nodes().sort((a, b) => (a.data("discoveredAt") - b.data("discoveredAt")) || a.data("label").localeCompare(b.data("label"), "ja")).forEach((node) => {
      const existing = state.sessionPositions.get(node.id());
      if (existing) { node.position(existing); return; }
      const lane = graphLane(node.data("type"));
      const row = laneCounts.get(lane) || 0;
      const position = { x: 90 + lane * 175, y: 80 + row * 76 };
      laneCounts.set(lane, row + 1); state.sessionPositions.set(node.id(), position); node.position(position);
    });
  }

  function renderGraph(nodeIds, edges, layoutName = "cose", showLabels = false) {
    const ids = new Set(nodeIds);
    const validEdges = edges.filter((edge) => ids.has(edge.source) && ids.has(edge.target));
    const elements = [
      ...[...ids].map((id) => state.nodeById.get(id)).filter(Boolean).map(toCyNode),
      ...validEdges.map((edge) => toCyEdge(edge, showLabels)),
    ];
    state.cy.elements().remove(); state.cy.add(elements); applyLayerVisibility();
    els.empty.classList.toggle("is-hidden", elements.length > 0);
    els.visibleCount.textContent = `${ids.size.toLocaleString()} nodes / ${validEdges.length.toLocaleString()} relations`;
    if (!elements.length) return;
    if (layoutName === "session") applySessionPositions();
    const options = layoutName === "breadthfirst"
      ? { name: "breadthfirst", directed: true, spacingFactor: 1.15, padding: 38, animate: false }
      : layoutName === "session"
        ? { name: "preset", fit: true, padding: 42, animate: false }
        : { name: "cose", idealEdgeLength: 82, nodeRepulsion: 6800, gravity: 0.34, numIter: 760, padding: 36, animate: false, randomize: true };
    state.cy.layout(options).run(); state.cy.fit(undefined, 38);
  }

  function bfs(starts, depth, allowedTypes = null) {
    const visited = new Set(starts); let frontier = new Set(starts);
    for (let level = 0; level < depth; level += 1) {
      const next = new Set();
      frontier.forEach((id) => (state.adjacency.get(id) || []).forEach((edge) => {
        if (allowedTypes && !allowedTypes.has(edge.type)) return;
        const other = edge.source === id ? edge.target : edge.source;
        if (!visited.has(other)) { visited.add(other); next.add(other); }
      }));
      frontier = next;
    }
    return visited;
  }

  function domainNode(domainId) {
    return state.nodes.find((node) => node.type === "BusinessDomain" && node.legacy_id === `domain:${domainId}`);
  }

  function updateExplorationPath() {
    if (!els.explorationPath) return;
    const labels = state.explorationTrail.map((id) => state.nodeById.get(id)?.name).filter(Boolean);
    els.explorationPath.textContent = labels.length ? `全社業務俯瞰  ›  ${labels.join("  ›  ")}` : "全社業務俯瞰  ›  ノードを選択して段階的に展開";
  }

  function addExplorationEdge(edge, addedNodeIds, addedEdgeIds) {
    if (!edge || state.explorationEdgeIds.has(edge._id)) return;
    state.explorationEdgeIds.add(edge._id); addedEdgeIds.add(edge._id);
    [edge.source, edge.target].forEach((id) => {
      if (!state.explorationNodeIds.has(id)) addedNodeIds.add(id);
      state.explorationNodeIds.add(id);
    });
  }

  function incidentEdges(nodeId, predicates, direction = "both") {
    return (state.adjacency.get(nodeId) || []).filter((edge) => {
      if (!predicates.has(edge.type)) return false;
      return direction === "both" || (direction === "out" && edge.source === nodeId) || (direction === "in" && edge.target === nodeId);
    });
  }

  function addDataHierarchy(tableId, addedNodeIds, addedEdgeIds) {
    incidentEdges(tableId, new Set(["storedIn"]), "out").forEach((tableToSchema) => {
      addExplorationEdge(tableToSchema, addedNodeIds, addedEdgeIds);
      incidentEdges(tableToSchema.target, new Set(["storedIn"]), "out").forEach((schemaToDatabase) => addExplorationEdge(schemaToDatabase, addedNodeIds, addedEdgeIds));
    });
  }

  function explorationOffset(type) {
    if (type === "BusinessDomain") return -260;
    if (type === "BusinessProcess") return -160;
    if (type === "BusinessEntity") return -40;
    if (["BusinessEvent", "BusinessMetric", "BusinessAttribute", "BusinessConcept"].includes(type)) return 90;
    if (type === "Database") return 220;
    if (type === "Schema") return 350;
    if (type === "Table") return 480;
    if (type === "Column") return 620;
    if (type === "SupportTicket") return -380;
    return 100;
  }

  function syncExplorationGraph(addedNodeIds, addedEdgeIds, focusNodeId) {
    const newNodes = [...addedNodeIds].map((id) => state.nodeById.get(id)).filter(Boolean)
      .filter((node) => state.cy.getElementById(node.id).length === 0);
    if (newNodes.length) state.cy.add(newNodes.map(toCyNode));
    const newEdges = [...addedEdgeIds].map((id) => state.edgeById.get(id)).filter(Boolean)
      .filter((edge) => state.cy.getElementById(edge._id).length === 0 && state.cy.getElementById(edge.source).length && state.cy.getElementById(edge.target).length);
    if (newEdges.length) state.cy.add(newEdges.map((edge) => toCyEdge(edge, true)));

    const focusPosition = state.cy.getElementById(focusNodeId).position() || { x: 0, y: 0 };
    const grouped = new Map();
    newNodes.forEach((node) => {
      const offset = explorationOffset(node.type);
      if (!grouped.has(offset)) grouped.set(offset, []);
      grouped.get(offset).push(node);
    });
    grouped.forEach((nodes, offset) => nodes.sort((a, b) => a.name.localeCompare(b.name, "ja")).forEach((node, index) => {
      const y = focusPosition.y + (index - (nodes.length - 1) / 2) * 58;
      state.cy.getElementById(node.id).position({ x: focusPosition.x + offset, y });
    }));

    const focusIds = new Set([focusNodeId, ...state.explorationTrail, ...addedNodeIds]);
    addedEdgeIds.forEach((edgeId) => {
      const edge = state.edgeById.get(edgeId);
      if (edge) { focusIds.add(edge.source); focusIds.add(edge.target); }
    });
    state.cy.nodes().forEach((node) => {
      node.toggleClass("exploration-focus", focusIds.has(node.id()));
      node.toggleClass("exploration-muted", !focusIds.has(node.id()));
    });
    state.cy.edges().forEach((edge) => {
      const focused = addedEdgeIds.has(edge.id()) || (focusIds.has(edge.source().id()) && focusIds.has(edge.target().id()));
      edge.toggleClass("exploration-focus", focused); edge.toggleClass("exploration-muted", !focused);
    });
    applyLayerVisibility(); updateExplorationPath();
    const focusCollection = state.cy.elements().filter((element) => focusIds.has(element.id()) || (element.isEdge() && addedEdgeIds.has(element.id())));
    if (focusCollection.length > 1) state.cy.fit(focusCollection, 72);
    state.focusZoomReference = state.cy.zoom(); applyLayerVisibility();
  }

  function updateExplorationTrail(nodeId) {
    const existingIndex = state.explorationTrail.indexOf(nodeId);
    if (existingIndex >= 0) state.explorationTrail = state.explorationTrail.slice(0, existingIndex + 1);
    else state.explorationTrail.push(nodeId);
  }

  function expandExplorationNode(nodeId) {
    const node = state.nodeById.get(nodeId); if (!node) return;
    if (node.type === "BusinessDomain" && els.domainSelect.value === "all" && node.legacy_id?.startsWith("domain:")) {
      const domainId = node.legacy_id.replace("domain:", "");
      els.domainSelect.value = domainId; renderOverview(domainId); showNodeDetail(nodeId); return;
    }
    updateExplorationTrail(nodeId);
    const addedNodeIds = new Set(); const addedEdgeIds = new Set();
    const addEdges = (edges, limit = 60) => edges.sort((a, b) => b.support_count - a.support_count).slice(0, limit)
      .forEach((edge) => addExplorationEdge(edge, addedNodeIds, addedEdgeIds));

    if (!state.expandedNodeIds.has(nodeId)) {
      if (node.type === "BusinessDomain") addEdges(incidentEdges(nodeId, new Set(["belongsToDomain"]), "in"));
      if (node.type === "BusinessProcess") {
        const entityEdges = incidentEdges(nodeId, new Set(["handlesEntity"]), "out"); addEdges(entityEdges);
        entityEdges.forEach((edge) => addEdges(incidentEdges(edge.target, new Set(["hasEvent", "measuredBy"]), "out"), 12));
      }
      if (node.type === "BusinessEntity") {
        addEdges(incidentEdges(nodeId, new Set(["hasEvent", "measuredBy", "backedBy"]), "out"));
        addEdges(incidentEdges(nodeId, new Set(["hasAttribute"]), "out"), 6);
      }
      if (node.type === "BusinessEvent") addEdges(incidentEdges(nodeId, new Set(["backedBy"]), "out"));
      if (node.type === "BusinessMetric") addEdges(incidentEdges(nodeId, new Set(["computedFrom"]), "out"));
      if (node.type === "BusinessAttribute") addEdges(incidentEdges(nodeId, new Set(["mappedToColumn"]), "out"));
      if (node.type === "BusinessConcept") addEdges(incidentEdges(nodeId, new Set(["resolvedTo"]), "out"));
      if (node.type === "Database") addEdges(incidentEdges(nodeId, new Set(["storedIn"]), "in"));
      if (node.type === "Schema") addEdges(incidentEdges(nodeId, new Set(["storedIn"]), "both"), 30);
      if (node.type === "Table") {
        addEdges(incidentEdges(nodeId, new Set(["storedIn"]), "out"));
        addEdges(incidentEdges(nodeId, new Set(["partOf"]), "in"), 30);
      }
      if (node.type === "Column") {
        addEdges(incidentEdges(nodeId, new Set(["partOf"]), "out"));
        addEdges(incidentEdges(nodeId, new Set(["mappedToColumn"]), "in"), 20);
      }
      if (node.type === "SupportTicket") addEdges(state.adjacency.get(nodeId) || [], 30);
      [...addedNodeIds].filter((id) => state.nodeById.get(id)?.type === "Table").forEach((tableId) => addDataHierarchy(tableId, addedNodeIds, addedEdgeIds));
      [...addedNodeIds].filter((id) => state.nodeById.get(id)?.type === "Column").forEach((columnId) => {
        incidentEdges(columnId, new Set(["partOf"]), "out").forEach((edge) => {
          addExplorationEdge(edge, addedNodeIds, addedEdgeIds); addDataHierarchy(edge.target, addedNodeIds, addedEdgeIds);
        });
      });
      state.expandedNodeIds.add(nodeId);
    }
    syncExplorationGraph(addedNodeIds, addedEdgeIds, nodeId);
  }

  function renderOverview(domainId = "all") {
    const allowed = state.nodes.filter((node) => overviewNodeTypes.has(node.type));
    let nodeIds = new Set(allowed.map((node) => node.id));
    let edges = state.edges.filter((edge) => overviewPredicates.has(edge.type));
    if (domainId !== "all") {
      const root = domainNode(domainId);
      if (root) nodeIds = bfs(new Set([root.id]), 2, overviewPredicates);
      edges = edges.filter((edge) => nodeIds.has(edge.source) && nodeIds.has(edge.target));
    }
    state.explorationNodeIds = new Set(nodeIds); state.explorationEdgeIds = new Set(edges.map((edge) => edge._id));
    state.expandedNodeIds.clear(); state.explorationTrail = domainId === "all" ? [] : [domainNode(domainId)?.id].filter(Boolean);
    state.semanticZoomReference = null; state.focusZoomReference = null;
    els.viewKicker.textContent = "PROGRESSIVE RDF EXPLORATION";
    els.viewTitle.textContent = domainId === "all" ? "8業務領域と業務プロセスの全体像" : `${domainNode(domainId)?.name || domainId}：選択してデータまで展開`;
    renderGraph(nodeIds, edges, "cose", domainId !== "all");
    state.semanticZoomReference = state.cy.zoom(); updateExplorationPath(); applyLayerVisibility();
  }

  function renderEntity360(nodeId) {
    const node = state.nodeById.get(nodeId); if (!node) return;
    switchView("entity", false); state.selectedNodeId = nodeId;
    const nodeIds = new Set([nodeId]);
    const selectedEdges = [];
    const addEdge = (edge) => {
      if (selectedEdges.some((item) => item._id === edge._id)) return;
      selectedEdges.push(edge); nodeIds.add(edge.source); nodeIds.add(edge.target);
    };
    const directTypes = new Set(["handlesEntity", "hasAttribute", "hasEvent", "measuredBy", "relatesToCustomer", "relatesToParty", "backedBy"]);
    const direct = (state.adjacency.get(nodeId) || []).filter((edge) => directTypes.has(edge.type));
    const attributes = direct.filter((edge) => edge.type === "hasAttribute").sort((a, b) => b.support_count - a.support_count).slice(0, 8);
    direct.filter((edge) => edge.type !== "hasAttribute").forEach(addEdge); attributes.forEach(addEdge);

    [...nodeIds].forEach((id) => {
      const neighbor = state.nodeById.get(id);
      const allowed = neighbor?.type === "BusinessAttribute" ? new Set(["mappedToColumn"])
        : neighbor?.type === "BusinessEvent" ? new Set(["backedBy"])
          : neighbor?.type === "BusinessMetric" ? new Set(["computedFrom"])
            : neighbor?.type === "BusinessProcess" ? new Set(["belongsToDomain"])
              : null;
      if (allowed) (state.adjacency.get(id) || []).filter((edge) => allowed.has(edge.type)).forEach(addEdge);
    });
    [...nodeIds].filter((id) => ["Table", "Schema"].includes(state.nodeById.get(id)?.type)).forEach((id) => {
      (state.adjacency.get(id) || []).filter((edge) => edge.type === "storedIn").forEach(addEdge);
    });
    const edges = selectedEdges.filter((edge) => nodeIds.has(edge.source) && nodeIds.has(edge.target));
    els.viewKicker.textContent = "SEMANTIC 360 / OWL INSTANCE";
    els.viewTitle.textContent = `${node.name}を中心とした意味関係`;
    renderGraph(nodeIds, edges, "cose", true);
    const selected = state.cy.getElementById(nodeId); if (selected.length) selected.select();
    showNodeDetail(nodeId);
  }

  function renderTicketPath(ticketId) {
    const ticket = state.ticketById.get(ticketId); if (!ticket) return;
    switchView("question", false);
    const ticketResourceId = state.ticketResourceById.get(ticketId);
    const nodeIds = new Set(ticketResourceId ? [ticketResourceId] : []);
    const selectedEdges = [];
    const addEdge = (edge) => {
      if (!edge || selectedEdges.some((item) => item._id === edge._id)) return;
      selectedEdges.push(edge); nodeIds.add(edge.source); nodeIds.add(edge.target);
    };
    const candidateAssetIds = new Set((ticket.candidate_asset_ids || []).slice(0, 3));
    const candidateTableIds = new Set(state.nodes.filter((node) => node.type === "Table" && candidateAssetIds.has(node.asset_id)).map((node) => node.id));

    (state.adjacency.get(ticketResourceId) || []).forEach((edge) => {
      const target = state.nodeById.get(edge.target);
      const keepMention = edge.type === "mentions" && ["BusinessEntity", "BusinessEvent", "BusinessMetric", "BusinessAttribute"].includes(target?.type);
      if (["aboutProcess", "resolvedBy"].includes(edge.type) || keepMention) addEdge(edge);
    });
    candidateTableIds.forEach((tableId) => {
      nodeIds.add(tableId);
      addEdge(state.edges.find((edge) => edge.source === ticketResourceId && edge.target === tableId && edge.type === "resolvedBy"));
    });

    [...nodeIds].filter((id) => state.nodeById.get(id)?.type === "BusinessProcess").forEach((processId) => {
      (state.adjacency.get(processId) || []).filter((edge) => edge.type === "belongsToDomain"
        || (edge.type === "handlesEntity" && edge.evidence_ticket_ids.includes(ticketId))).forEach(addEdge);
    });
    [...nodeIds].filter((id) => state.nodeById.get(id)?.type === "BusinessEntity").forEach((entityId) => {
      (state.adjacency.get(entityId) || []).filter((edge) => ["hasEvent", "measuredBy"].includes(edge.type)
        && edge.evidence_ticket_ids.includes(ticketId)).forEach(addEdge);
    });
    [...nodeIds].filter((id) => ["BusinessEvent", "BusinessMetric", "BusinessAttribute"].includes(state.nodeById.get(id)?.type)).forEach((semanticId) => {
      (state.adjacency.get(semanticId) || []).filter((edge) => ["backedBy", "computedFrom", "mappedToColumn"].includes(edge.type)
        && (candidateTableIds.has(edge.target) || state.nodeById.get(edge.target)?.type === "Column")
        && edge.evidence_ticket_ids.includes(ticketId)).forEach(addEdge);
    });

    const preferredNames = ["metric_value", "amount", "event_timestamp", "business_date", "quality_status_code", "snapshot_timestamp"];
    candidateTableIds.forEach((tableId) => {
      (state.adjacency.get(tableId) || []).filter((edge) => edge.type === "storedIn" && edge.source === tableId).forEach((tableToSchema) => {
        addEdge(tableToSchema);
        (state.adjacency.get(tableToSchema.target) || []).filter((edge) => edge.type === "storedIn" && edge.source === tableToSchema.target).forEach(addEdge);
      });
      const table = state.nodeById.get(tableId); const asset = state.assetById.get(table?.asset_id);
      const preferredColumns = [...(asset?.columns || [])].sort((a, b) => Number(b.is_key) - Number(a.is_key)
        || (preferredNames.includes(a.name) ? preferredNames.indexOf(a.name) : 99) - (preferredNames.includes(b.name) ? preferredNames.indexOf(b.name) : 99)).slice(0, 3);
      preferredColumns.forEach((column) => {
        const columnId = `res:column/${asset.database}.${asset.schema}.${asset.table}.${column.name}`;
        addEdge((state.adjacency.get(columnId) || []).find((edge) => edge.type === "partOf" && edge.target === tableId));
      });
    });
    const edges = selectedEdges.filter((edge) => nodeIds.has(edge.source) && nodeIds.has(edge.target));
    els.viewKicker.textContent = `${ticketId} / RDF EVIDENCE PATH`;
    els.viewTitle.textContent = ticket.question; els.questionSearch.value = ticket.question;
    renderGraph(nodeIds, edges, "breadthfirst", true);
    state.cy.edges().filter((edge) => ["evidence", "mapping"].includes(edge.data("layer"))).addClass("highlighted");
    showTicketDetail(ticket);
  }

  function applyLayerVisibility() {
    if (!state.cy) return;
    const zoomReference = state.focusZoomReference || state.semanticZoomReference;
    const zoomRatio = state.view === "overview" && zoomReference ? state.cy.zoom() / zoomReference : 1;
    const semanticVisible = (type) => {
      if (state.view !== "overview") return true;
      if (zoomRatio < 0.38) return ["BusinessDomain", "Database"].includes(type);
      if (zoomRatio < 0.62) return ["BusinessDomain", "BusinessProcess", "Database", "Schema"].includes(type);
      if (zoomRatio < 0.82) return !["BusinessAttribute", "BusinessEvent", "BusinessMetric", "Column", "SupportTicket"].includes(type);
      return true;
    };
    const modelVisible = (layer) => state.view !== "overview" || state.explorationFilter === "all" || layer === state.explorationFilter;
    state.cy.nodes().forEach((node) => {
      const focusedDetail = state.view === "overview" && state.explorationTrail.length > 1 && state.focusZoomReference && zoomRatio >= 0.72;
      const contextVisible = !focusedDetail || !node.hasClass("exploration-muted");
      const visible = state.activeLayers.has(node.data("layer")) && modelVisible(node.data("layer")) && semanticVisible(node.data("type")) && contextVisible;
      node.style("display", visible ? "element" : "none");
    });
    state.cy.edges().forEach((edge) => {
      const filterAllowsEdge = state.view !== "overview" || state.explorationFilter === "all" || edge.data("layer") === state.explorationFilter;
      const visible = state.activeLayers.has(edge.data("layer")) && filterAllowsEdge
        && edge.source().style("display") !== "none" && edge.target().style("display") !== "none";
      edge.style("display", visible ? "element" : "none");
    });
    const visibleNodes = state.cy.nodes().filter((node) => node.style("display") !== "none").length;
    const visibleEdges = state.cy.edges().filter((edge) => edge.style("display") !== "none").length;
    els.visibleCount.textContent = `${visibleNodes.toLocaleString()} nodes / ${visibleEdges.toLocaleString()} relations`;
    renderTypeLegend();
  }

  function renderTypeLegend() {
    if (!els.typeLegend || !state.cy) return;
    const order = ["BusinessDomain", "BusinessProcess", "BusinessEntity", "BusinessEvent", "BusinessMetric", "BusinessAttribute", "Database", "Schema", "Table", "Column", "SupportTicket"];
    const visibleTypes = new Set(state.cy.nodes().filter((node) => node.style("display") !== "none").map((node) => node.data("type")));
    const types = order.filter((type) => visibleTypes.has(type));
    els.typeLegend.innerHTML = types.length
      ? `<p class="type-legend-title">表示中のノード形状</p>${types.map((type) => `<div class="type-legend-item"><span class="type-shape" data-type="${type}"></span>${escapeHtml(typeLabels[type] || type)}</div>`).join("")}`
      : "";
  }

  function catalogContextForNode(node) {
    if (node.type === "Table") return { asset: state.assetById.get(node.asset_id), column: null };
    if (node.type !== "Column") return { asset: null, column: null };
    const tableEdge = (state.adjacency.get(node.id) || []).find((edge) => edge.type === "partOf" && edge.source === node.id);
    const tableNode = tableEdge ? state.nodeById.get(tableEdge.target) : null;
    const asset = tableNode ? state.assetById.get(tableNode.asset_id) : null;
    const column = asset?.columns?.find((item) => item.name === node.name) || null;
    return { asset, column };
  }

  function showNodeDetail(nodeId) {
    const node = state.nodeById.get(nodeId); if (!node) return;
    if (node.type === "SupportTicket") {
      const ticket = state.ticketById.get(node.name); if (ticket) { showTicketDetail(ticket); return; }
    }
    state.selectedNodeId = nodeId; els.detailEmpty.classList.add("is-hidden"); els.detailContent.classList.remove("is-hidden");
    els.detailType.textContent = `${typeLabels[node.type] || node.type} / ${node.type}`;
    els.detailName.textContent = node.name;
    els.detailDescription.textContent = node.description || "過去QAまたはデータ構造から生成されたRDFリソースです。";
    const catalog = catalogContextForNode(node);
    const facts = [
      ["RDF IRI", node.id], ["OWL Class", `bank:${node.type}`], ["支持件数", node.support_count],
      ["生成元", node.source_type], ["データ型", node.data_type], ["ドメイン", node.domain],
      ["Asset ID", node.asset_id], ["物理名", node.physical_name],
      ["データオーナー", catalog.asset?.owner], ["スチュワード", catalog.asset?.steward],
      ["更新頻度", catalog.asset?.update_frequency], ["機密区分", catalog.asset?.confidentiality],
      ["個人情報", catalog.asset ? (catalog.asset.personal_data ? "あり" : "なし") : ""],
      ["キーカラム", catalog.column ? (catalog.column.is_key ? "はい" : "いいえ") : ""],
    ].filter(([, value]) => value !== undefined && value !== null && value !== "" && value !== 0);
    els.detailFacts.innerHTML = facts.map(([label, value]) => `<div><dt>${escapeHtml(label)}</dt><dd>${escapeHtml(String(value))}</dd></div>`).join("");
    const ticketIds = new Set(node.evidence_ticket_ids || []);
    (state.adjacency.get(nodeId) || []).forEach((edge) => edge.evidence_ticket_ids.forEach((id) => ticketIds.add(id)));
    const evidence = [...ticketIds].slice(0, 5).map((id) => state.ticketById.get(id)).filter(Boolean);
    els.detailEvidence.innerHTML = evidence.length
      ? `<h3>RDF関係の根拠QA</h3>${evidence.map((ticket) => `<div class="evidence-item"><button data-ticket-id="${ticket.ticket_id}">${escapeHtml(ticket.question)}</button><span>${ticket.ticket_id} / ${escapeHtml(ticket.domain_name)}</span></div>`).join("")}`
      : "<h3>生成根拠</h3><p class=\"section-copy\">データ構造資料から抽出されたリソースです。</p>";
    els.detailEvidence.querySelectorAll("[data-ticket-id]").forEach((button) => button.addEventListener("click", () => renderTicketPath(button.dataset.ticketId)));
  }

  function showTicketDetail(ticket) {
    els.detailEmpty.classList.add("is-hidden"); els.detailContent.classList.remove("is-hidden");
    els.detailType.textContent = `${ticket.ticket_id} / SupportTicket`;
    els.detailName.textContent = ticket.subdomain_name; els.detailDescription.textContent = ticket.answer;
    const facts = [["業務領域", ticket.domain_name], ["依頼者", ticket.requester_role], ["確信度", ticket.confidence], ["候補資産", ticket.candidate_asset_ids.join(", ")]];
    els.detailFacts.innerHTML = facts.map(([label, value]) => `<div><dt>${escapeHtml(label)}</dt><dd>${escapeHtml(String(value))}</dd></div>`).join("");
    els.detailEvidence.innerHTML = `<h3>質問</h3><div class="evidence-item"><button>${escapeHtml(ticket.question)}</button><span>合成QA / RDF根拠ノード</span></div>`;
    state.selectedNodeId = null;
  }

  function renderEntityResults(query = "") {
    const normalized = query.trim().toLowerCase();
    const entities = state.nodes.filter((node) => node.type === "BusinessEntity" && (!normalized || node.name.toLowerCase().includes(normalized))).slice(0, 10);
    els.entityResults.innerHTML = entities.map((node) => `<button class="result-button" data-node-id="${node.id}"><strong>${escapeHtml(node.name)}</strong><span>owl:Class bank:BusinessEntity / ${node.support_count || 0}件のQA</span></button>`).join("");
    els.entityResults.querySelectorAll("[data-node-id]").forEach((button) => button.addEventListener("click", () => renderEntity360(button.dataset.nodeId)));
  }

  function searchTickets(query) {
    const value = query.trim(); if (!value) return state.tickets.filter((ticket) => ticket.response_type === "answer").slice(0, 6);
    return state.tickets.map((ticket) => {
      let score = 0; const haystack = `${ticket.question} ${ticket.answer} ${ticket.business_concepts.join(" ")} ${ticket.domain_name} ${ticket.subdomain_name}`;
      if (haystack.includes(value)) score += 20;
      ticket.business_concepts.forEach((concept) => { if (value.includes(concept)) score += 8; });
      [...value].filter((char) => char.trim()).forEach((char) => { if (haystack.includes(char)) score += 0.05; });
      return { ticket, score };
    }).filter((entry) => entry.score > 0.5).sort((a, b) => b.score - a.score || b.ticket.confidence - a.ticket.confidence).slice(0, 8).map((entry) => entry.ticket);
  }

  function renderTicketResults(query) {
    const tickets = searchTickets(query);
    els.ticketResults.innerHTML = tickets.length
      ? tickets.map((ticket) => `<button class="result-button" data-ticket-id="${ticket.ticket_id}"><strong>${escapeHtml(ticket.question)}</strong><span>${escapeHtml(ticket.domain_name)} / ${escapeHtml(ticket.subdomain_name)} / 確信度 ${ticket.confidence}</span></button>`).join("")
      : "<p class=\"section-copy\">関連するQAが見つかりませんでした。</p>";
    els.ticketResults.querySelectorAll("[data-ticket-id]").forEach((button) => button.addEventListener("click", () => renderTicketPath(button.dataset.ticketId)));
  }

  function selectorMatches(node, selector = {}) {
    if (!node) return false;
    if (selector.id && node.id !== selector.id) return false;
    if (selector.type && node.type !== selector.type) return false;
    if (selector.label && !node.name.toLowerCase().includes(String(selector.label).toLowerCase())) return false;
    return true;
  }

  function resolveSelector(selector, limit = 10) {
    if (!selector || typeof selector !== "object") throw new Error("startまたはtargetの指定が必要です");
    const matches = state.nodes.filter((node) => selectorMatches(node, selector));
    matches.sort((a, b) => {
      const exactA = selector.label && a.name === selector.label ? 1 : 0;
      const exactB = selector.label && b.name === selector.label ? 1 : 0;
      return exactB - exactA || b.support_count - a.support_count;
    });
    return matches.slice(0, limit);
  }

  function compactNode(node) {
    const { asset, column } = catalogContextForNode(node);
    const fullyQualifiedName = asset
      ? [asset.database, asset.schema, asset.table, node.type === "Column" ? node.name : null].filter(Boolean).join(".")
      : undefined;
    return {
      id: node.id, type: node.type, label: node.name,
      description: node.description || undefined, supportCount: node.support_count || undefined,
      dataType: node.data_type || undefined, assetId: node.asset_id || undefined,
      domain: node.domain || asset?.domain || undefined,
      database: asset?.database, schema: asset?.schema, table: asset?.table,
      fullyQualifiedName, owner: asset?.owner, steward: asset?.steward,
      updateFrequency: asset?.update_frequency, confidentiality: asset?.confidentiality,
      personalData: asset?.personal_data, isKey: column?.is_key,
    };
  }

  function compactEdge(edge) {
    const source = state.nodeById.get(edge.source); const target = state.nodeById.get(edge.target);
    return {
      source: { id: edge.source, label: source?.name }, predicate: edge.type,
      target: { id: edge.target, label: target?.name }, supportCount: edge.support_count || undefined,
      confidence: edge.confidence || undefined,
    };
  }

  function collectEvidence(nodeIds, edges, limit = 5) {
    const ticketIds = new Set();
    nodeIds.forEach((id) => (state.nodeById.get(id)?.evidence_ticket_ids || []).forEach((ticketId) => ticketIds.add(ticketId)));
    edges.forEach((edge) => edge.evidence_ticket_ids.forEach((ticketId) => ticketIds.add(ticketId)));
    return [...ticketIds].map((id) => state.ticketById.get(id)).filter(Boolean).sort((a, b) => b.confidence - a.confidence).slice(0, limit).map((ticket) => ({
      ticketId: ticket.ticket_id, question: ticket.question, answer: ticket.answer,
      responseType: ticket.response_type, confidence: ticket.confidence,
    }));
  }

  function summarizeEvidence(evidence) {
    const grouped = new Map();
    evidence.forEach((item) => {
      const key = `${item.responseType}\u0000${item.answer}`;
      if (!grouped.has(key)) grouped.set(key, {
        responseType: item.responseType, answer: item.answer,
        ticketIds: [], questions: [], confidences: [],
      });
      const group = grouped.get(key);
      group.ticketIds.push(item.ticketId); group.questions.push(item.question); group.confidences.push(item.confidence);
    });
    const confidences = evidence.map((item) => Number(item.confidence)).filter(Number.isFinite);
    return {
      ticketCount: evidence.length,
      distinctAnswerCount: grouped.size,
      answerTicketCount: evidence.filter((item) => item.responseType === "answer").length,
      clarificationTicketCount: evidence.filter((item) => item.responseType === "clarify").length,
      confidence: confidences.length ? {
        min: Math.min(...confidences), max: Math.max(...confidences),
        average: Number((confidences.reduce((sum, value) => sum + value, 0) / confidences.length).toFixed(3)),
      } : null,
      groups: [...grouped.values()].map((group) => ({
        responseType: group.responseType, answer: group.answer,
        ticketIds: group.ticketIds, questions: group.questions,
        confidenceMin: Math.min(...group.confidences), confidenceMax: Math.max(...group.confidences),
      })),
    };
  }

  function executeResolveTerms(query) {
    if (!Array.isArray(query.terms) || !query.terms.length) throw new Error("termsを1件以上指定してください");
    const nodes = [];
    const resolved = query.terms.map((term) => {
      const candidates = state.nodes.filter((node) => node.name.toLowerCase().includes(String(term).toLowerCase()))
        .sort((a, b) => (b.name === term) - (a.name === term) || b.support_count - a.support_count)
        .slice(0, Math.min(Number(query.limit) || 5, 10));
      candidates.forEach((node) => nodes.push(node));
      return { term, candidates: candidates.map(compactNode) };
    });
    return { result: { ok: true, operation: query.operation, resolved, nextSuggestedOperation: "find_path" }, nodes, edges: [] };
  }

  function executeFindPath(query) {
    if (!Array.isArray(query.steps) || !query.steps.length || query.steps.length > 5) throw new Error("stepsは1〜5段階で指定してください");
    const starts = resolveSelector(query.start, Math.min(Number(query.limit) || 10, 20));
    if (!starts.length) throw new Error("開始リソースが見つかりません");
    const contextTicketIds = new Set(starts.flatMap((node) => node.evidence_ticket_ids || []));
    const nodeIds = new Set(starts.map((node) => node.id));
    const selectedEdges = [];
    const traversal = [];
    let frontier = new Set(nodeIds);
    for (const [index, step] of query.steps.entries()) {
      if (!step.predicate || !predicateLabels[step.predicate]) throw new Error(`steps[${index}].predicateは許可されたOWLプロパティを指定してください`);
      const direction = step.direction || "out";
      if (!["out", "in", "both"].includes(direction)) throw new Error(`steps[${index}].directionはout / in / bothのいずれかです`);
      const next = new Set();
      const from = [...frontier].map((id) => state.nodeById.get(id)).filter(Boolean).map(compactNode);
      frontier.forEach((sourceId) => (state.adjacency.get(sourceId) || []).forEach((edge) => {
        if (edge.type !== step.predicate) return;
        if (contextTicketIds.size && edge.evidence_ticket_ids.length
          && !edge.evidence_ticket_ids.some((ticketId) => contextTicketIds.has(ticketId))) return;
        const followsOut = edge.source === sourceId && ["out", "both"].includes(direction);
        const followsIn = edge.target === sourceId && ["in", "both"].includes(direction);
        if (!followsOut && !followsIn) return;
        const targetId = followsOut ? edge.target : edge.source;
        const target = state.nodeById.get(targetId);
        if (!selectorMatches(target, step.target || {})) return;
        if (!selectedEdges.some((item) => item._id === edge._id)) selectedEdges.push(edge);
        nodeIds.add(targetId); next.add(targetId);
      }));
      if (!next.size) throw new Error(`ステップ${index + 1}（${step.predicate}）に一致する経路がありません`);
      traversal.push({
        step: index + 1, predicate: step.predicate, direction, from,
        to: [...next].map((id) => state.nodeById.get(id)).filter(Boolean).map(compactNode),
      });
      frontier = next;
    }

    if ((query.include || []).includes("columns")) {
      [...nodeIds].filter((id) => state.nodeById.get(id)?.type === "Table").forEach((tableId) => {
        (state.adjacency.get(tableId) || []).filter((edge) => edge.type === "partOf" && edge.target === tableId).slice(0, 20).forEach((edge) => {
          if (!selectedEdges.some((item) => item._id === edge._id)) selectedEdges.push(edge);
          nodeIds.add(edge.source);
        });
      });
    }

    [...nodeIds].filter((id) => state.nodeById.get(id)?.type === "Table").forEach((tableId) => {
      (state.adjacency.get(tableId) || []).filter((edge) => edge.type === "storedIn" && edge.source === tableId).forEach((tableToSchema) => {
        if (!selectedEdges.some((item) => item._id === tableToSchema._id)) selectedEdges.push(tableToSchema);
        nodeIds.add(tableToSchema.target);
        (state.adjacency.get(tableToSchema.target) || []).filter((edge) => edge.type === "storedIn" && edge.source === tableToSchema.target).forEach((schemaToDatabase) => {
          if (!selectedEdges.some((item) => item._id === schemaToDatabase._id)) selectedEdges.push(schemaToDatabase);
          nodeIds.add(schemaToDatabase.target);
        });
      });
    });
    const rawEvidence = (query.include || []).includes("evidence") ? collectEvidence(nodeIds, selectedEdges, 5) : [];
    const evidenceSummary = summarizeEvidence(rawEvidence);
    const nodes = [...nodeIds].map((id) => state.nodeById.get(id)).filter(Boolean);
    return {
      result: {
        ok: true, operation: query.operation,
        summary: `${starts.map((node) => node.name).join("、")}から${query.steps.length}段階を探索し、${frontier.size}件へ到達しました。`,
        traversal, nodes: nodes.map(compactNode), relations: selectedEdges.map(compactEdge),
        evidence: evidenceSummary.groups, evidenceSummary: { ...evidenceSummary, groups: undefined },
        nextSuggestedOperation: rawEvidence.length ? "compose_answer" : "get_evidence",
      }, nodes, edges: selectedEdges,
    };
  }

  function executeGetEvidence(query) {
    const selectors = Array.isArray(query.resources) ? query.resources : [];
    if (!selectors.length) throw new Error("resourcesにRDF IRIまたはセレクタを指定してください");
    const nodes = selectors.flatMap((selector) => {
      if (typeof selector === "string") {
        const node = state.nodeById.get(selector);
        if (!node) throw new Error(`RDF IRIが見つかりません: ${selector}`);
        return [node];
      }
      const matches = resolveSelector(selector, 10);
      if (matches.length > 1) {
        throw new Error(`resourcesの指定が曖昧です。前の結果で返されたRDF IRIを指定してください: ${matches.map((node) => node.id).join(", ")}`);
      }
      return matches;
    });
    const nodeIds = new Set(nodes.map((node) => node.id));
    const resourceNodeIds = new Set(nodeIds);
    const adjacentEdges = [...nodeIds].flatMap((id) => state.adjacency.get(id) || []).filter((edge, index, all) => all.findIndex((item) => item._id === edge._id) === index);
    let rawEvidence = collectEvidence(nodeIds, adjacentEdges, Math.min(Number(query.limit) || 5, 20));
    const scopedDomains = new Set(nodes.filter((node) => dataNodeTypes.has(node.type)).map((node) => catalogContextForNode(node).asset?.domain || node.domain).filter(Boolean));
    if (scopedDomains.size) {
      rawEvidence = rawEvidence.filter((item) => scopedDomains.has(state.ticketById.get(item.ticketId)?.domain));
    } else {
      const evidenceDomains = new Set(rawEvidence.map((item) => state.ticketById.get(item.ticketId)?.domain).filter(Boolean));
      if (evidenceDomains.size > 1) throw new Error("根拠が複数の業務領域にまたがります。find_pathで得たTableまたはColumnのRDF IRIもresourcesへ追加してください");
    }
    const evidenceSummary = summarizeEvidence(rawEvidence);
    const evidenceIds = new Set(rawEvidence.map((item) => item.ticketId));
    const evidenceNodeIds = new Set([...evidenceIds].map((ticketId) => state.ticketResourceById.get(ticketId)).filter(Boolean));
    evidenceNodeIds.forEach((id) => nodeIds.add(id));
    const evidenceEdges = state.edges.filter((edge) => {
      const directTicketLink = evidenceNodeIds.has(edge.source) && resourceNodeIds.has(edge.target);
      const supportedRelation = edge.evidence_ticket_ids.some((ticketId) => evidenceIds.has(ticketId)) && resourceNodeIds.has(edge.source) && resourceNodeIds.has(edge.target);
      return directTicketLink || supportedRelation;
    });
    const resultNodes = [...nodeIds].map((id) => state.nodeById.get(id)).filter(Boolean);
    return {
      result: {
        ok: true, operation: query.operation, resources: nodes.map(compactNode),
        evidence: evidenceSummary.groups, evidenceSummary: { ...evidenceSummary, groups: undefined },
        nextSuggestedOperation: "compose_answer",
      },
      nodes: resultNodes, edges: evidenceEdges,
    };
  }

  function sessionEdges() {
    return state.edges.filter((edge) => state.sessionEdgeIds.has(edge._id));
  }

  function updateAgentProgress(finalized = false) {
    const types = new Set([...state.sessionNodeIds].map((id) => state.nodeById.get(id)?.type));
    let current = types.size ? 0 : -1;
    if ([...types].some((type) => ["BusinessAttribute", "BusinessEvent", "BusinessMetric", "BusinessConcept", "BusinessAction"].includes(type))) current = 1;
    if ([...types].some((type) => dataNodeTypes.has(type))) current = 2;
    if (types.has("SupportTicket")) current = 3;
    if (finalized) current = 4;
    els.agentPhases.forEach((phase, index) => {
      phase.classList.toggle("is-complete", index < current || finalized);
      phase.classList.toggle("is-current", index === current && !finalized);
    });
  }

  function renderSessionGraph() {
    const edges = sessionEdges();
    const nodeIds = new Set(state.sessionNodeIds);
    edges.forEach((edge) => { nodeIds.add(edge.source); nodeIds.add(edge.target); });
    renderGraph(nodeIds, edges, "session", true);
    state.cy.nodes().addClass("session-visited"); state.cy.edges().addClass("session-visited");
    state.frontierNodeIds.forEach((id) => state.cy.getElementById(id).addClass("session-frontier"));
    state.cy.edges().filter((edge) => state.frontierNodeIds.has(edge.source().id()) || state.frontierNodeIds.has(edge.target().id())).addClass("session-frontier");
  }

  function accumulateExecution(execution) {
    const step = state.queryRuns.length;
    state.frontierNodeIds = new Set();
    execution.nodes.forEach((node) => {
      if (!state.sessionNodeIds.has(node.id)) state.sessionNodeStep.set(node.id, step);
      state.sessionNodeIds.add(node.id); state.frontierNodeIds.add(node.id);
    });
    execution.edges.forEach((edge) => {
      state.sessionEdgeIds.add(edge._id);
      [edge.source, edge.target].forEach((id) => {
        if (!state.sessionNodeIds.has(id)) state.sessionNodeStep.set(id, step);
        state.sessionNodeIds.add(id);
      });
    });
  }

  function buildAnswerPackage() {
    const nodes = [...state.sessionNodeIds].map((id) => state.nodeById.get(id)).filter(Boolean);
    const edges = sessionEdges();
    const tables = nodes.filter((node) => node.type === "Table");
    const metrics = nodes.filter((node) => node.type === "BusinessMetric");
    const events = nodes.filter((node) => node.type === "BusinessEvent");
    const businessContext = nodes.filter((node) => ["BusinessDomain", "BusinessProcess", "BusinessEntity"].includes(node.type))
      .sort((a, b) => graphLane(a.type) - graphLane(b.type)).map((node) => ({ type: node.type, label: node.name }));
    const semanticConcepts = nodes.filter((node) => ["BusinessConcept", "BusinessAttribute", "BusinessEvent", "BusinessMetric", "BusinessAction"].includes(node.type))
      .map((node) => ({ type: node.type, label: node.name }));
    const recommendedData = tables.map((table) => {
      const asset = state.assetById.get(table.asset_id);
      const columnIds = edges.filter((edge) => edge.type === "partOf" && edge.target === table.id).map((edge) => edge.source);
      const columns = columnIds.map((id) => state.nodeById.get(id)).filter(Boolean);
      return {
        assetId: table.asset_id || undefined, database: asset?.database, schema: asset?.schema,
        table: asset?.table || table.name,
        fullyQualifiedName: asset ? [asset.database, asset.schema, asset.table].filter(Boolean).join(".") : table.name,
        description: asset?.description || table.description, owner: asset?.owner, steward: asset?.steward,
        updateFrequency: asset?.update_frequency, confidentiality: asset?.confidentiality,
        personalData: asset?.personal_data,
        columns: columns.map((column) => {
          const catalogColumn = asset?.columns?.find((item) => item.name === column.name);
          return {
            name: column.name, fullyQualifiedName: asset ? [asset.database, asset.schema, asset.table, column.name].filter(Boolean).join(".") : column.name,
            description: catalogColumn?.description || column.description,
            dataType: catalogColumn?.data_type || column.data_type || undefined,
            isKey: catalogColumn?.is_key || false,
          };
        }),
      };
    });
    const reachedTicketIds = nodes.filter((node) => node.type === "SupportTicket").map((node) => node.name);
    const rawEvidence = reachedTicketIds.length
      ? reachedTicketIds.map((id) => state.ticketById.get(id)).filter(Boolean).sort((a, b) => b.confidence - a.confidence).slice(0, 8).map((ticket) => ({
        ticketId: ticket.ticket_id, question: ticket.question, answer: ticket.answer,
        responseType: ticket.response_type, confidence: ticket.confidence,
      }))
      : collectEvidence(new Set(state.sessionNodeIds), edges, 8);
    const evidenceSummary = summarizeEvidence(rawEvidence);
    const unresolvedQuestions = [...new Set(rawEvidence.filter((item) => item.responseType === "clarify")
      .flatMap((item) => state.ticketById.get(item.ticketId)?.followup_questions || []))].slice(0, 5);
    if (!state.sessionQuestion) unresolvedQuestions.unshift("回答対象となる元の業務質問を確認してください。");
    const semanticTargetText = [...metrics, ...events].map((node) => node.name).join("・") || "対象業務概念";
    const tableText = recommendedData.map((item) => item.fullyQualifiedName).join("、") || "候補テーブル未特定";
    const columnText = recommendedData.flatMap((item) => item.columns.map((column) => column.name)).join("、") || "カラム未特定";
    const keyText = recommendedData.flatMap((item) => item.columns.filter((column) => column.isKey).map((column) => column.name)).join("、") || "キー候補未特定";
    const hasColumns = recommendedData.some((item) => item.columns.length > 0);
    const ready = Boolean(state.sessionQuestion) && tables.length > 0 && hasColumns && rawEvidence.length > 0;
    const output = {
      ok: true,
      operation: "compose_answer",
      status: ready ? "ready_to_answer" : "continue_search",
      originalQuestion: state.sessionQuestion || null,
      answerDraft: ready
        ? `「${state.sessionQuestion}」に対して、${semanticTargetText}の主候補は${tableText}です。利用候補カラムは${columnText}、キー候補は${keyText}です。${evidenceSummary.ticketCount}件の過去QAを根拠としており、業務定義・アクセス権・実データでの結合条件は担当者確認が必要です。`
        : "回答に必要なデータ候補または根拠QAが不足しています。探索を継続してください。",
      businessContext,
      semanticConcepts,
      recommendedData,
      rdfRelations: edges.map(compactEdge),
      evidence: evidenceSummary.groups,
      evidenceSummary: { ...evidenceSummary, groups: undefined },
      unresolvedQuestions,
      usageNotes: [
        "このPoCは公開情報から推定した合成データです。実在するSMBCのデータ構造を示すものではありません。",
        "機密区分・個人情報フラグ・データオーナーを確認し、必要なアクセス承認を取得してください。",
        "物理結合条件と指標定義はデータスチュワードまたは業務オーナーに確認してください。",
      ],
      trace: { steps: state.queryRuns.length, nodes: state.sessionNodeIds.size, relations: state.sessionEdgeIds.size },
      syntheticData: true,
      generatedAt: new Date().toISOString(),
    };
    els.copilotResult.value = JSON.stringify(output, null, 2);
    state.queryRuns.push({ operation: "compose_answer", ok: ready, summary: ready ? `${tables.length}件のデータ候補と${rawEvidence.length}件の根拠から回答案を生成` : "探索継続が必要" });
    renderQueryHistory(); updateAgentProgress(ready);
    els.viewKicker.textContent = "AGENT ANSWER PACKAGE";
    els.viewTitle.textContent = ready ? "業務・データ・根拠をつないだ回答案" : "回答に必要な探索が未完了";
    return output;
  }

  function resetQuerySession() {
    state.queryRuns = []; state.sessionNodeIds.clear(); state.sessionEdgeIds.clear(); state.sessionNodeStep.clear();
    state.sessionPositions.clear(); state.frontierNodeIds.clear(); state.sampleQueryIndex = 0; state.sessionQuestion = "";
    els.copilotQuery.value = JSON.stringify(sampleCopilotQueries[0], null, 2); els.copilotResult.value = "";
    renderQueryHistory(); updateAgentProgress(); renderCopilotWelcome();
  }

  function executeCopilotQuery() {
    try {
      const query = JSON.parse(els.copilotQuery.value);
      if (typeof query.question === "string" && query.question.trim()) state.sessionQuestion = query.question.trim();
      const allowed = { resolve_terms: executeResolveTerms, find_path: executeFindPath, get_evidence: executeGetEvidence };
      if (!allowed[query.operation]) throw new Error(`operationは${Object.keys(allowed).join(" / ")}のいずれかです`);
      const execution = allowed[query.operation](query);
      state.queryRuns.push({ operation: query.operation, ok: true, summary: `${execution.nodes.length}件を取得` });
      accumulateExecution(execution);
      const output = {
        ...execution.result,
        session: {
          step: state.queryRuns.length,
          originalQuestion: state.sessionQuestion || null,
          accumulatedNodes: state.sessionNodeIds.size,
          accumulatedRelations: state.sessionEdgeIds.size,
          currentFrontier: [...state.frontierNodeIds],
        },
        executedAt: new Date().toISOString(), syntheticData: true,
      };
      state.queryRuns[state.queryRuns.length - 1].summary = output.summary || `${execution.nodes.length}件を取得`;
      els.copilotResult.value = JSON.stringify(output, null, 2);
      renderQueryHistory();
      els.viewKicker.textContent = `COPILOT TOOL / STEP ${state.queryRuns.length}`;
      els.viewTitle.textContent = output.summary || `${query.operation}の実行結果`;
      renderSessionGraph(); updateAgentProgress();
    } catch (error) {
      const output = { ok: false, error: error.message, allowedOperations: ["resolve_terms", "find_path", "get_evidence"] };
      els.copilotResult.value = JSON.stringify(output, null, 2);
      state.queryRuns.push({ operation: "validation", ok: false, summary: error.message }); renderQueryHistory();
    }
  }

  function renderQueryHistory() {
    els.queryHistory.innerHTML = state.queryRuns.map((run, index) => `<div class="query-step ${run.ok ? "is-success" : "is-error"}"><span>STEP ${index + 1}</span><strong>${escapeHtml(run.operation)}</strong><p>${escapeHtml(run.summary)}</p></div>`).join("");
  }

  function renderCopilotWelcome() {
    if (state.sessionNodeIds.size) { renderSessionGraph(); updateAgentProgress(); return; }
    const nodeIds = new Set(state.nodes.filter((node) => overviewNodeTypes.has(node.type)).map((node) => node.id));
    const edges = state.edges.filter((edge) => nodeIds.has(edge.source) && nodeIds.has(edge.target) && overviewPredicates.has(edge.type));
    els.viewKicker.textContent = "COPILOT AGENT / BUSINESS OVERVIEW"; els.viewTitle.textContent = "業務モデル俯瞰から探索を開始";
    renderGraph(nodeIds, edges, "cose", false);
  }

  function updateAnswerDemoProgress(current) {
    els.answerDemoProgress.forEach((phase, index) => {
      phase.classList.toggle("is-complete", current >= els.answerDemoProgress.length || index < current);
      phase.classList.toggle("is-current", index === current);
    });
  }

  async function typeAnswerDemoStatus(message) {
    els.answerDemoStatus.textContent = "";
    for (const character of message) {
      els.answerDemoStatus.textContent += character;
      await new Promise((resolve) => window.setTimeout(resolve, 14));
    }
  }

  function renderAnswerDemoActivity(index, stage, completedMessage = "") {
    let item = els.answerDemoLog.querySelector(`[data-demo-log="${index}"]`);
    if (!item) {
      els.answerDemoLog.insertAdjacentHTML("beforeend", `<article class="demo-log-item is-current" data-demo-log="${index}">
        <div class="demo-log-head"><strong>STEP ${index + 1} / ${escapeHtml(stage.title)}</strong><span class="thinking-dots">検討中</span></div>
        <p>判断要約：${escapeHtml(stage.reasoning)}</p>
        <p class="demo-log-action">実行：${escapeHtml(stage.action)}</p>
      </article>`);
      item = els.answerDemoLog.querySelector(`[data-demo-log="${index}"]`);
    }
    if (completedMessage) {
      item.classList.remove("is-current"); item.classList.add("is-complete");
      item.querySelector(".demo-log-head span").className = ""; item.querySelector(".demo-log-head span").textContent = "完了";
      item.insertAdjacentHTML("beforeend", `<p class="demo-log-result">結果：${escapeHtml(completedMessage)}</p>`);
    }
    item.scrollIntoView({ block: "nearest", behavior: "smooth" });
  }

  function renderAnswerDemoWelcome() {
    els.questionSearch.value = answerDemoQuestion;
    updateAnswerDemoProgress(-1);
    els.answerDemoStatus.textContent = "「自動デモを開始」を押すと、検証済みの探索を段階的に再生します。";
    els.answerDemoLog.innerHTML = "";
    els.answerDemoFinal.className = "answer-demo-final is-pending";
    els.ticketResults.innerHTML = '<p class="answer-demo-placeholder">探索が完了すると、自然言語の回答がここに表示されます。</p>';
    const nodeIds = new Set(state.nodes.filter((node) => overviewNodeTypes.has(node.type)).map((node) => node.id));
    const edges = state.edges.filter((edge) => nodeIds.has(edge.source) && nodeIds.has(edge.target) && overviewPredicates.has(edge.type));
    els.viewKicker.textContent = "AGENT ANSWER EXPERIENCE / READY";
    els.viewTitle.textContent = "固定質問から回答生成までを自動再生";
    renderGraph(nodeIds, edges, "cose", false);
  }

  function renderAnswerDemoResult(output) {
    els.answerDemoFinal.className = "answer-demo-final is-ready";
    const data = output.recommendedData?.[0];
    if (!data || output.status !== "ready_to_answer") {
      els.ticketResults.innerHTML = `<div class="answer-card"><h3>回答を生成できませんでした</h3><p>${escapeHtml(output.answerDraft || "探索結果を確認してください。")}</p></div>`;
      return;
    }
    const keyColumns = data.columns.filter((column) => column.isKey).map((column) => column.name);
    const importantNames = new Set(["business_date", "metric_value", "housing_loan_id", "customer_id", "quality_status_code", "snapshot_timestamp"]);
    const importantColumns = data.columns.filter((column) => importantNames.has(column.name));
    const confidence = output.evidenceSummary?.confidence;
    els.ticketResults.innerHTML = `<article class="answer-card">
      <h3>延滞率の日次確認に使うデータ</h3>
      <p>主な参照先は <code>${escapeHtml(data.fullyQualifiedName)}</code> です。住宅ローンの延滞率を日次集計するスナップショットとして利用します。</p>
      <ul>${importantColumns.map((column) => `<li><code>${escapeHtml(column.name)}</code>：${escapeHtml(column.description || "用途確認が必要")}</li>`).join("")}</ul>
      <p>キー候補は <code>${escapeHtml(keyColumns.join(", "))}</code>、更新頻度は <strong>${escapeHtml(data.updateFrequency || "要確認")}</strong> です。</p>
      <p>機密区分は <strong>${escapeHtml(data.confidentiality || "要確認")}</strong>、個人情報は <strong>${data.personalData ? "あり" : "なし"}</strong> です。利用前に${escapeHtml(data.owner || "データオーナー")}と${escapeHtml(data.steward || "データスチュワード")}へ確認してください。</p>
      <p>類似QA ${output.evidenceSummary?.ticketCount || 0}件を根拠とし、確信度は${confidence ? `${confidence.min}〜${confidence.max}（平均${confidence.average}）` : "要確認"}です。</p>
      <p class="answer-caution">この回答は公開情報から推定したPoC用の合成データに基づきます。実在するSMBCのデータ構造を示すものではありません。</p>
    </article>`;
    els.answerDemoFinal.scrollIntoView({ block: "start", behavior: "smooth" });
  }

  async function runAnswerDemo() {
    if (state.answerDemoRunning) return;
    state.answerDemoRunning = true; els.answerDemoButton.disabled = true; els.answerDemoButton.textContent = "エージェントが探索中…";
    const stages = [
      { title: "質問理解", reasoning: "質問は住宅ローンの延滞率という集計指標と、日次データ・利用条件を求めています。", action: "業務語をRDF上の業務対象と指標へ解決します。" },
      { title: "業務文脈", reasoning: "同名概念の混入を避けるため、住宅ローン契約が属する業務領域とプロセスを確認します。", action: "業務対象からプロセス、業務領域の順に関係を探索します。" },
      { title: "データ特定", reasoning: "延滞率は明細イベントではなく集計指標なので、算出元のスナップショットを優先します。", action: "指標からテーブルへ進み、DB・スキーマ・主要カラムを取得します。" },
      { title: "根拠確認", reasoning: "候補データを確定する前に、類似QAとの整合性と利用上の注意点を確認します。", action: "指標とテーブルのIRIを使い、根拠QAと確信度を取得します。" },
      { title: "回答生成", reasoning: "業務文脈、物理データ、根拠、ガバナンス情報が揃いました。", action: "業務ユーザー向けの自然言語回答へ統合します。" },
    ];
    const completedMessages = [
      "「住宅ローン契約」と「延滞率」を特定しました。",
      "リテール領域の住宅ローン業務であることを確認しました。",
      "日次スナップショットと主要カラムを特定しました。",
      "類似QAによる裏付けを確認しました。",
    ];
    try {
      resetQuerySession(); els.questionSearch.value = answerDemoQuestion; els.answerDemoLog.innerHTML = "";
      els.answerDemoFinal.className = "answer-demo-final is-running";
      els.ticketResults.innerHTML = '<p class="answer-demo-placeholder"><span class="thinking-dots">探索結果を整理しています</span></p>';
      els.answerDemoStatus.textContent = "業務モデル全体を俯瞰し、探索の起点を確認しています。";
      await new Promise((resolve) => window.setTimeout(resolve, 1000));
      for (let index = 0; index < sampleCopilotQueries.length; index += 1) {
        updateAnswerDemoProgress(index); renderAnswerDemoActivity(index, stages[index]);
        els.viewKicker.textContent = `AGENT AUTO DEMO / STEP ${index + 1} OF 5`;
        els.viewTitle.textContent = `STEP ${index + 1}｜${stages[index].title}`;
        await typeAnswerDemoStatus(`${stages[index].title}：${stages[index].reasoning}`);
        await new Promise((resolve) => window.setTimeout(resolve, 900));
        els.copilotQuery.value = JSON.stringify(sampleCopilotQueries[index], null, 2); executeCopilotQuery();
        const result = JSON.parse(els.copilotResult.value);
        if (!result.ok) throw new Error(result.error || "探索に失敗しました");
        els.viewKicker.textContent = `AGENT AUTO DEMO / STEP ${index + 1} OF 5`;
        els.viewTitle.textContent = `${stages[index].title}｜${completedMessages[index]}`;
        renderAnswerDemoActivity(index, stages[index], completedMessages[index]);
        await typeAnswerDemoStatus(`${completedMessages[index]} 次の探索へ進みます。`);
        await new Promise((resolve) => window.setTimeout(resolve, 3200));
      }
      updateAnswerDemoProgress(4); renderAnswerDemoActivity(4, stages[4]);
      els.viewKicker.textContent = "AGENT AUTO DEMO / STEP 5 OF 5";
      els.viewTitle.textContent = "STEP 5｜回答生成";
      await typeAnswerDemoStatus("回答生成：業務・データ・根拠を統合しています。");
      await new Promise((resolve) => window.setTimeout(resolve, 2700));
      const output = buildAnswerPackage();
      renderAnswerDemoActivity(4, stages[4], "推奨データ、主要カラム、利用条件、根拠を含む回答を生成しました。");
      updateAnswerDemoProgress(5); renderAnswerDemoResult(output);
      await typeAnswerDemoStatus(`回答生成が完了しました。${output.trace.nodes}ノード、${output.trace.relations}関係を探索しました。`);
    } catch (error) {
      els.answerDemoStatus.textContent = `デモを完了できませんでした：${error.message}`;
    } finally {
      state.answerDemoRunning = false; els.answerDemoButton.disabled = false; els.answerDemoButton.textContent = "もう一度再生";
    }
  }

  function switchView(view, render = true) {
    state.view = view;
    document.querySelectorAll(".view-trigger").forEach((button) => button.classList.toggle("is-active", button.dataset.view === view));
    document.getElementById("ai-menu").classList.toggle("is-active", ["question", "copilot"].includes(view));
    document.getElementById("explore-menu").classList.toggle("is-active", ["overview", "entity"].includes(view));
    els.graphModelFilter.classList.toggle("is-hidden", view !== "overview");
    els.explorationPath.classList.toggle("is-hidden", view !== "overview");
    ["overview", "entity", "question", "copilot"].forEach((name) => document.getElementById(`${name}-controls`).classList.toggle("is-hidden", name !== view));
    if (!render) return;
    if (view === "overview") renderOverview(els.domainSelect.value);
    if (view === "entity") {
      renderEntityResults(els.entitySearch.value);
      const first = state.nodes.find((node) => node.type === "BusinessEntity" && node.name === "住宅ローン契約") || state.nodes.find((node) => node.type === "BusinessEntity");
      if (first) renderEntity360(first.id);
    }
    if (view === "question") {
      renderAnswerDemoWelcome();
    }
    if (view === "copilot") renderCopilotWelcome();
  }

  function setMenuCollapsed(collapsed) {
    state.menuCollapsed = collapsed;
    els.controlPanel.classList.toggle("is-collapsed", collapsed);
    els.workspace.classList.toggle("is-menu-collapsed", collapsed);
    els.menuToggle.setAttribute("aria-expanded", String(!collapsed));
    els.menuToggle.setAttribute("aria-label", collapsed ? "メニューを開く" : "メニューを閉じる");
    window.setTimeout(() => {
      if (!state.cy) return;
      state.cy.resize(); state.cy.fit(undefined, 38);
    }, 200);
  }

  function populateDomains() {
    state.nodes.filter((node) => node.type === "BusinessDomain").sort((a, b) => a.name.localeCompare(b.name, "ja")).forEach((node) => {
      const option = document.createElement("option"); option.value = node.legacy_id.replace("domain:", ""); option.textContent = node.name; els.domainSelect.appendChild(option);
    });
  }

  function bindEvents() {
    document.querySelectorAll(".view-trigger").forEach((button) => button.addEventListener("click", () => switchView(button.dataset.view)));
    els.menuToggle.addEventListener("click", () => setMenuCollapsed(!state.menuCollapsed));
    document.querySelectorAll("[data-model-filter]").forEach((button) => button.addEventListener("click", () => {
      state.explorationFilter = button.dataset.modelFilter;
      document.querySelectorAll("[data-model-filter]").forEach((item) => item.classList.toggle("is-active", item === button));
      applyLayerVisibility();
      const visible = state.cy.elements().filter((element) => element.style("display") !== "none");
      if (visible.length) state.cy.fit(visible, 46);
    }));
    els.domainSelect.addEventListener("change", () => renderOverview(els.domainSelect.value));
    document.getElementById("focus-retail").addEventListener("click", () => { els.domainSelect.value = "retail"; renderOverview("retail"); });
    els.entitySearch.addEventListener("input", () => renderEntityResults(els.entitySearch.value));
    els.answerDemoButton.addEventListener("click", runAnswerDemo);
    document.getElementById("load-query-sample").addEventListener("click", () => {
      state.sampleQueryIndex = (state.sampleQueryIndex + 1) % sampleCopilotQueries.length;
      els.copilotQuery.value = JSON.stringify(sampleCopilotQueries[state.sampleQueryIndex], null, 2);
    });
    document.getElementById("execute-copilot-query").addEventListener("click", executeCopilotQuery);
    document.getElementById("reset-query-session").addEventListener("click", resetQuerySession);
    document.getElementById("build-answer-package").addEventListener("click", buildAnswerPackage);
    document.getElementById("copy-copilot-result").addEventListener("click", async () => {
      if (!els.copilotResult.value) return;
      if (navigator.clipboard?.writeText) await navigator.clipboard.writeText(els.copilotResult.value);
      else { els.copilotResult.select(); document.execCommand("copy"); }
      document.getElementById("copy-copilot-result").textContent = "コピーしました";
      window.setTimeout(() => { document.getElementById("copy-copilot-result").textContent = "結果をコピー"; }, 1400);
    });
    document.getElementById("fit-graph").addEventListener("click", () => {
      if (state.view === "overview") {
        state.focusZoomReference = null; state.cy.elements().removeClass("exploration-muted exploration-focus"); applyLayerVisibility();
      }
      const visible = state.cy.elements().filter((element) => element.style("display") !== "none");
      state.cy.fit(visible.length ? visible : undefined, 38);
    });
    document.getElementById("export-graph").addEventListener("click", () => {
      const link = document.createElement("a"); link.href = state.cy.png({ full: true, scale: 2, bg: "#f7faf8" }); link.download = `rdf-knowledge-graph-${state.view}.png`; link.click();
    });
    document.getElementById("expand-selection").addEventListener("click", () => {
      if (!state.selectedNodeId) return;
      if (state.view === "overview") expandExplorationNode(state.selectedNodeId); else renderEntity360(state.selectedNodeId);
    });
    document.querySelectorAll(".legend-item").forEach((button) => button.addEventListener("click", () => {
      const layer = button.dataset.layer;
      if (state.activeLayers.has(layer)) state.activeLayers.delete(layer); else state.activeLayers.add(layer);
      button.classList.toggle("is-disabled", !state.activeLayers.has(layer)); button.setAttribute("aria-pressed", String(state.activeLayers.has(layer))); applyLayerVisibility();
    }));
  }

  function escapeHtml(value) {
    return String(value).replace(/[&<>'"]/g, (char) => ({ "&": "&amp;", "<": "&lt;", ">": "&gt;", "'": "&#39;", '"': "&quot;" }[char]));
  }

  async function boot() {
    try {
      const embeddedGraph = document.getElementById("embedded-knowledge-graph");
      const embeddedTickets = document.getElementById("embedded-support-tickets");
      const embeddedCatalog = document.getElementById("embedded-data-catalog");
      if (embeddedGraph && embeddedTickets && embeddedCatalog) {
        state.document = JSON.parse(embeddedGraph.textContent);
        state.tickets = JSON.parse(embeddedTickets.textContent).tickets;
        state.assets = JSON.parse(embeddedCatalog.textContent).assets;
      } else {
        const [graphResponse, ticketResponse, catalogResponse] = await Promise.all([
          fetch("/data/ontology/knowledge_graph.jsonld"), fetch("/data/support/synthetic_support_tickets.json"), fetch("/data/catalog/data_catalog.json"),
        ]);
        if (!graphResponse.ok || !ticketResponse.ok || !catalogResponse.ok) throw new Error("データの取得に失敗しました");
        state.document = await graphResponse.json(); state.tickets = (await ticketResponse.json()).tickets; state.assets = (await catalogResponse.json()).assets;
      }
      parseJsonLd(state.document); buildIndexes(); initGraph(); populateDomains(); bindEvents(); renderEntityResults(); switchView("question");
      els.copilotQuery.value = JSON.stringify(sampleCopilotQueries[0], null, 2);
      els.status.textContent = `${state.nodes.length.toLocaleString()} RDF resources / ${state.edges.length.toLocaleString()} relations`;
      if (els.standardCount) els.standardCount.textContent = `OWL ${state.classCount} classes / ${state.propertyCount} properties`;
    } catch (error) {
      els.status.textContent = "読み込みエラー"; els.empty.textContent = error.message; els.empty.classList.remove("is-hidden");
    }
  }

  boot();
})();

</script>
</body>
</html>
